### Jewellery
- **SG:SR/03338/26**, Ring, The product contains an excessive concentration of cadmium, which is harmful to health, accumulates in the body, and may cause cancer and organ damage. Notified by Luxembourg. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10118847)
- **SG:SR/03428/26**, Jewellery set, The product contains an excessive concentration of cadmium, which can accumulate in the body, damage kidneys and bones, and potentially cause cancer. Notified by Belgium. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119905)
- **SG:SR/03418/26**, Earrings, The product contains excessive concentrations of cadmium and has a high rate of nickel release, posing risks of cancer, organ damage, and severe allergic skin reactions. Notified by Belgium. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119834)
- **SG:SR/03403/26**, Earrings, The product has an excessively high rate of nickel release, which can cause allergic skin reactions during direct and prolonged contact. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119802)
- **SG:SR/03452/26**, Earrings, The product exhibits a high rate of nickel release, which may cause allergic reactions with prolonged direct skin contact. Notified by Malta. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119799)
- **SG:SR/03451/26**, Earrings — Shein, The product releases nickel at too high a rate, presenting a risk of allergic reactions from direct and prolonged skin contact. Notified by Malta. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119800)

### Toys
- **SG:SR/03436/26**, Sensory toy — kids game, The toy produces dangerously high sound pressure levels that can cause hearing loss, contains easily detachable small parts posing a choking hazard, and features strong magnets that can cause intestinal blockage or perforation if swallowed. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119755)
- **SG:SR/03360/26**, Arcade game toy — Hisab-joker AB, The product contains excessive concentrations of lead, cadmium, DEHP, DBP, and short-chain chlorinated paraffins, posing significant chemical risks to human health and the environment. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119726)
- **SG:SR/03361/26**, Toy microphone — Peerless Performer, The product contains excessive levels of DEHP, lead, and cadmium, posing risks to human health and the environment. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119741)
- **SG:SR/03359/26**, Doll, The product contains excessive concentrations of cadmium in its solders and DEHP in its plastic parts, posing environmental and health risks. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119702)
- **SG:SR/03405/26**, LED jumping rope, The plastic rope and solders contain excessive concentrations of DBP and lead, posing risks to the environment and reproductive health. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119792)
- **SG:SR/03443/26**, Toy sewing machine — Yihuitoys, The product's solders contain excessive concentrations of cadmium and lead, which bioaccumulate and pose environmental risks. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119769)
- **SG:SR/03435/26**, Toy water gun — IKONKA, The product's solders contain an excessive concentration of lead, posing a risk to the environment. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119451)
- **SG:SR/03416/26**, Slime toy, The migration of boron from the slime is excessively high, which can harm children's reproductive systems through ingestion or contact. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119631)
- **SG:SR/03446/26**, Toy steak — UPKOCH, The migration of toxic organotin compounds from the product is too high, posing potential health risks. Notified by Luxembourg. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119716)
- **SG:SR/03402/26**, Plastic toy — XCSJ, The plastic material contains an excessive concentration of organic tin, which can cause nervous system damage, hormone disruption, and irritation. Notified by Luxembourg. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119723)
- **SG:INFO/00001/26**, Toy slime, The decorative lollipop in the kit contains an excessive concentration of DEHP, which may cause damage to the reproductive system. Notified by Sweden. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119790)
- **SG:SR/03351/26**, Toy pram — LOVELY BABY BARROW, The toy stroller can fold over while a child is sitting in it, trapping and crushing fingers. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119646)
- **SG:SR/03401/26**, Fancy-dress mask, The mask is non-permeable and lacks sufficient ventilation, creating a suffocation hazard if it covers the mouth and nose. Notified by United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119617)
- **SG:SR/03408/26**, Educational toy — aiyingle, The toy contains small detachable balls that present choking and nasal aspiration suffocation hazards. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119647)
- **SG:SR/03369/26**, Push-along toy, The toy contains small parts that can cause small children to choke if put in the mouth. Notified by Belgium. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119789)
- **SG:SR/03447/26**, Expandable toy — Tiger, Parts of the toy can easily detach into small pieces, posing a choking hazard for small children. Notified by Spain. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119808)
- **SG:SR/03444/26**, Keyring with soft toy — KEEL TOYS, The toy features a small rotating disc that can easily detach and cause a choking hazard. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119796)
- **SG:SR/03423/26**, Soft toy — UOUOROSE, Parts of the toy such as the nose, chains, and eyes can easily detach, presenting a choking hazard for small children. Notified by Austria. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119801)

### Hand tools
- **SG:SR/03439/26**, Screwdriver — FACOM, The screwdriver lacks adequate electrical insulation despite markings indicating otherwise, posing a risk of electric shock when used near live components. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119677)

### Protective equipment

### Cosmetics

Notified by Germany. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119753)
- **SG:SR/03413/26**, Shower gel, The product is contaminated with a high concentration of aerobic mesophilic bacteria and Serratia species, which can cause infections in vulnerable consumers. - **SG:SR/03419/26**, Aftershave lotion — Mondial 1908, The product contains BMHCA, a prohibited ingredient that can harm the reproductive system and cause skin sensitization. Notified by Italy. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119732)
- **SG:SR/03420/26**, Eau de toilette — Mondial 1908, The product contains BMHCA, which is prohibited in cosmetics and may harm the reproductive system and cause skin sensitization. Notified by Italy. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119733)
- **SG:SR/03421/26**, Hand soap — Mondial 1908, The product contains the prohibited substance BMHCA, posing risks to the reproductive system and skin sensitization. Notified by Italy. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119734)
- **SG:SR/03422/26**, Perfume — Lancome Paris, The product contains prohibited BMHCA, which can cause skin sensitization and reproductive harm. Notified by Italy. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119735)

### Clothing, textiles and fashion items
- **SG:SR/03410/26**, Fancy-dress costume, The visor's fabric contains excessive concentrations of DEHP and PAHs, which may damage the reproductive system and cause cancer. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119772)
- **SG:SR/03411/26**, Fancy-dress costume, The product's plastic material contains an excessive concentration of DEHP, which may cause damage to the reproductive system. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119774)
- **SG:SR/03356/26**, Children's hoodie — NEXT STAR, The hoodie features long drawstrings with free ends at the neck area, creating a strangulation hazard if trapped during activities. Notified by Romania. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119773)

### Other - Guardrail
- **SG:SR/03441/26**, Guardrail for French window — BCIE SARL / VARAN, The guardrail is insufficiently high and has excessive spacing between rails, presenting a fall hazard for children. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119770)

### Stationery
- **SG:SR/03415/26**, Plastic case, The product contains an excessive concentration of DEHP in its plastic material, which may cause damage to the reproductive system. Notified by Cyprus. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119779)

### Motor vehicles
- **SG:SR/03450/26**, Passenger car — Citroën, Improperly installed retaining pins in converted driving school vehicles can cause the brake pedal linkage to misalign and fail to return fully, increasing injury risks. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119793)
- **SG:SR/03448/26**, Passenger car — Lexus and Toyota, The airbag propellant can degrade over time, potentially causing the inflator to fragment and injure occupants when deployed. Notified by France. [Link](https://ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/screen/webReport/alertDetail/10119831)

### Laser pointers

Jewellery

Toys

  • SG:SR/03436/26, Sensory toy — kids game, The toy produces dangerously high sound pressure levels that can cause hearing loss, contains easily detachable small parts posing a choking hazard, and features strong magnets that can cause intestinal blockage or perforation if swallowed. Notified by France. ec.europa.eu
